policy.scope: Permanent product terminology and compatibility governance. This slice adds checks and does not rename live modules, packages, hosts, persisted keys, or historical content.
policy.deprecatedAliasMatching: Case-insensitive exact phrase matching for configured aliases; user-facing source literals are scanned, while code/path compatibility remains explicitly allowlisted.
policy.allowlistRule: Every compatibility exception is path-scoped, term-scoped, owned, justified, evidenced, and expires at a named removal gate. Wildcards are intentionally narrow.
policy.historyRule: Immutable history is readable but never rewritten for naming. New source files cannot inherit a history exception unless they match an explicitly immutable historical path.
